today.linkRequests_one: {{count}} person wants to join your care team.
today.linkRequests_other: {{count}} people want to join your care team.
today.restBody: No exercises today. Rest well, and see you tomorrow.
today.allDoneTitle: All done for today. Well done!
today.allDoneBody: Your exercises for today are finished.
today.againHint: An extra session is saved, but only the sessions your plan asks for count.
today.nudge: {{name}} sent you a gentle nudge. You can do it!
today.nudgeFormer: Your family sent you a gentle nudge. You can do it!
today.reminderOffer: Get a reminder on this phone every day at {{time}}.

sleeve.title: Sleeve
sleeve.noneBody: When you have a Kneedit sleeve, it shows here. For now, you tap Done after each exercise.
sleeve.sampleIntro: This is sample data, to show what the sleeve will measure. It is not from your knee.
sleeve.angleBody: A straight leg is 0 degrees. The line shows the last few seconds.

friends.title: Friends
friends.intro: Friends see your streak and this week's progress. Nothing else.
friends.empty: No friends yet. Share your code, or add a friend's code below.
friends.sentRequest: Request sent, waiting for them to accept
friends.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? You'll stop seeing each other's progress.
friends.codeHint: 6 letters and numbers, from their Friends screen
friends.sent: Request sent. You'll see their name once they accept.
friends.myCodeBody: Give this code to friends who use Kneedit.
friends.shareMessage: Add me as a friend on Kneedit. My friend code is {{code}}.

linked.title: Family and physiotherapist
linked.intro: Only people you approve can see your progress. You can remove anyone at any time.
linked.empty: Nobody yet. Give your link code below to family or your physiotherapist.

request.physio: {{name}} wants to join as your physiotherapist.

requestShares.caregiver: Family see your streak and sessions, and, if you share it, your weekly report.
requestShares.physio: Your physiotherapist sees your exercise records and can set your programme.

linked.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? They stop seeing your progress at once.
linked.codeBody: Family and your physiotherapist type this code, or scan the QR code, to ask to link to you.
linked.qrLabel: QR code of your link code
linked.newCodeConfirm: Get a new code? The old one stops working. People already linked stay linked.

profile.title: Profile
profile.sharingIntro: Your physiotherapist always sees your exercise records.
profile.shareReportBody: Family see which days you exercised, your answers and your steps.
profile.shareFallsBody: Family are told when the sleeve detects a possible fall.
profile.leaderboardBody: Friends see your streak and this week's progress.

progress.rank: Number {{rank}} of {{total}} on your friends' leaderboard

session.title: Today's session
session.extraBody: You've done today's sessions. This one is saved, but it won't count towards your week.
session.onBreak: You're on a break. Take your time, and tap Resume when you're ready.
session.doneHint: Saves this exercise, then asks two questions
session.endEarlyHint: Asks first. The exercises you finished are saved.
session.endEarlyConfirm: End the session now? The exercises you finished are saved, but the session won't count towards your week.
session.noVideo: There is no video for this exercise yet. Follow the steps below.
session.videoUnavailable: The video can't play right now. Follow the steps below.

body.counted: This session counts towards your week.
body.extra: You had already done today's sessions, so this one doesn't count towards your week.
body.ended: The exercises you finished are saved. Only finished sessions count towards your week.

leaderboard.title: This week's leaderboard
leaderboard.rule: Ranked by this week's sessions done, as a percentage. A tie goes to the longer streak.
leaderboard.empty: Add friends to see who is keeping up this week.

programme.title: Your programme
programme.draft: Draft, pending clinician sign-off. Your physiotherapist can change it.
programme.askPhysio: Only your physiotherapist can change your programme. Ask them at your next visit.

visits.title: Your visits
visits.intro: Visits with your physiotherapist. Your physiotherapist books them.

reminder.title: Daily reminder
reminder.webOnly: Reminders show on your phone. Open Kneedit on your phone to turn them on.
reminder.on: The reminder is on for this phone, every day at {{time}}.
reminder.off: The reminder is off on this phone.
reminder.denied: Notifications are off for Kneedit. You can allow them in your phone's settings.
